draft.emotion: neat and ready to head out, fastening the laces before standing up
notes: Usually used in the plural (los zapatos) to refer to a pair of shoes.
Use zapato for dress or everyday shoes. For athletic shoes, Mexican Spanish uses los tenis, and for sandals, las sandalias or las chanclas.

senses.definition: An item of footwear with a firm sole that covers the foot.

examples.text: Me compré unos zapatos nuevos para la fiesta.
examples.translation: I bought some new shoes for the party.

translations.from: Prenda de calzado que cubre el pie y parte del tobillo, hecha de cuero, tela u otros materiales.
translations.to: An item of footwear that covers the foot and part of the ankle, made of leather, cloth, or other materials.
